desc:
🚀 Survive 100 Days In Space! 👽

You've crash-landed on a mysterious alien planet! 🌌 Can you survive 100 days?

🛸 Fight off dangerous aliens and UFOs!
⛏️ Collect resources and craft useful items!
🏗️ Build defenses and protect your base!
👨‍🚀 Rescue 4 missing kids with special abilities!
🚗 Unlock rovers and explore the planet!
☄️ Survive meteor showers and mysterious events!
🏆 Earn badges and become the ultimate space survivor!

🌟 Team up with friends or try to survive on your own!

💫 HOW MANY DAYS CAN YOU SURVIVE?
